title: Five Winters and One Short Chart
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：eye　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 eye 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my grandmother ① tested an eye that no nurse in the clinic would have recorded, and she said the testing was the whole of the winter. The ② eye, meaning the organ itself and not the sight, ran five winters and stayed unrecorded in the book; an eye, she said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ eye in that clinic had the same short chart beside it, and the ④ eye at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the child and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An eye, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; my grandmother said the recording is the part that fills five winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the eye was the whole of the needle, meaning the hole and not the organ. The ⑥ eye, meaning the hole and not any of that, is the only thing in a needle that everybody waits for and nobody records; eye, he said, is either something you test or the only word that means both an organ and a hole. He said the hole is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ eye had become a line in a card, and the card had become an argument about the short chart. The ⑧ eye of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one clinic and five winters of recording; eye, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to record. She said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ eye I remember is the one recorded in the card, which closed in 1963 and is still described as the quietest in the clinic. An ⑩ eye, my mother said in 1965, is the only one that improves by being recorded; every eye, she said, is a hole that has agreed to look like an organ. She said the hole was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 眼睛（指诊所里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 眼睛（指那只器官本身，与视力相对）
C. 固定搭配：test an eye 检查一只眼睛
D. n. 眼睛（指留给孩子的那一档）
E. n. 眼睛（抽象总称，指一间诊所的检查之事）
F. n. 眼睛（指卡片上写到、被记下的那只）
G. n. 针眼；孔（指一根针上人人都等却无人记下的那样东西）
H. n. 孔（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人记下的那样东西）

items.q: tested an eye that no nurse in the clinic would have recorded

answers.why: test an eye 意为“检查一只眼睛”，1956 年祖母检查了一只诊所里没有一位护士肯记下的眼睛。
eye 意为“眼睛”，指那只器官本身而不是视力，它经过了五个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
eye 意为“眼睛”，指诊所里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一张短短的视力表。
eye 意为“眼睛”，指留给孩子的那一档，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
eye 意为“针眼、孔”，指一根针上人人都等却无人记下的那样东西，叔叔说这个针眼就是那根针的全部。
eye 意为“孔”，指人人都等却无人记下的那样东西而不是那只眼睛，是针上人人都等、却无人记下的东西。
eye 意为“眼睛”，指卡片上写到、被记下的那只，到 1961 年这一只成了卡片里的一行。
eye 意为“眼睛”，祖母一月写道，整件事的检查之事是一间诊所和五个冬天的记下。
eye 意为“眼睛”，我记得的是卡片上记下的那只，1963 年结束了，至今仍被说成诊所里最安静的一只。
eye 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，一只眼睛是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的东西。
